summary: The change adds the documented system service unit, removes the stale pre-rename unit, narrows the browser stop hook to a tracked script with explicit Deno permissions, and documents the operator-owned prerequisites. Unit files and docs are consistent, and the new process-query logic fails closed on errors.

evidence: systemd/user/ubiquity-prospector.service now exists and declares User and Group ubiquity-prospector, StateDirectory and CacheDirectory, Restart, NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome, PrivateTmp, and a pinned ExecStart for /srv/ubiquity-prospector/current/vps.ts.

systemd/user/ubiquity-sales-nav-browser.service ExecStop now runs the tracked scripts/sales-nav-browser-stop.ts with explicit allow-env, allow-read, allow-net, and allow-run entries; the untracked ~/.local/libexec copy and deno run -A are gone, and a new test covers the permission-safe process queries.

The stale linkedin-scraper-2025.service was deleted, unit paths are %h-relative or under /srv, and docs/vps-release.md documents the system-versus-user ownership, hardening, and operator-supplied runtime prerequisites.
